Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.player.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the game, holding all their resources, bonuses, buildings, and village state.

Supports both normal construction (via Player(String, ColorPawnEnum)) and full deserialization from a saved snapshot (via the JsonCreator constructor). All mutable state (food, stars, PP, bonuses, etc.) is managed through dedicated methods rather than direct field access.

  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player(String nickname, ColorPawnEnum colorPawn)
      Constructs a new player with default (zero) resource values and no active bonuses.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's unique nickname; must not be null
      colorPawn - the color assigned to this player's pawn; must not be null

    • Player

      public Player(String nickname, ColorPawnEnum colorPawn, int pps, int nFood, int nStars, int totBuildDisc, int foodDiscount, Village myVillage, List<Building> myBuilds, List<Action> skippableDraws, boolean ppProtection, boolean doubleShamanIncome, boolean huntBonus, Set<CardTypeEnum> categoryDiscounts, boolean paintBonus, boolean extraFoodOnQueue)
      Constructs a fully initialised Player from a saved snapshot.

      Used by Jackson during deserialization; all parameters map directly to their corresponding JSON properties.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's unique nickname
      colorPawn - the color of the player's pawn
      pps - prestige points
      nFood - amount of food
      nStars - number of stars
      totBuildDisc - total building discount
      foodDiscount - flat food discount for feast costs
      myVillage - the player's village
      myBuilds - list of owned buildings
      skippableDraws - list of pending skippable draw actions
      ppProtection - whether PP loss protection is active
      doubleShamanIncome - whether double shaman income is active
      huntBonus - whether the hunt bonus is active
      categoryDiscounts - card categories granting a feast discount
      paintBonus - whether the paint bonus is active
      extraFoodOnQueue - whether extra food on queue tiles is active
